Bobby is an applications engineer in our Electrical Connections business segment in Solon, Ohio. His journey with us began in January 2021 while he was still a student. He has excelled in various roles across our rotational program, gaining invaluable experience in applications engineering, manufacturing, and customer-facing issues.


At nVent, Bobby found a company that encourages employees to bring bold ideas, be authentic and build the future of a more sustainable and electrified world:[https://www.nvent.com/en-us/early-careers-nvent](https://www.nvent.com/en-us/early-careers-nvent) .
